transcript: Most people think they are tired because life is hard. But in my years, I have seen something else. They are tired because their body never feels safe enough to rest. Even when the day ends, the nervous system stays awake. The mind keeps watch, the heart remains alert. This is why sleep does not come easily. This is why the mind over-thinks. This is why silence feels uncomfortable. Not because something is wrong with you, but because your body learned that stillness was not safe. So it stayed ready, always prepared, always protecting. You do not need to fight this. You do not need to fix it. You need to teach the body slowly, gently, that this moment is different, that nothing is chasing you, that it can soften, that it can rest. This is not done with effort. It is done with safety, repeated, patient, quiet safety. My new eBook, The Way Back to Stillness, is in the link in my bio. Not to change who you are, but to help your body remember what peace feels like.
